chapters.label: Act I
chapters.title: What I could not always say
prose: I was never very good at saying the important things while I was standing inside them. Sometimes I joked. Sometimes I over-explained. Sometimes I went quiet and hoped you would somehow hear what I could not arrange properly into words.
What I was trying to say was simple: being seen by you mattered to me.

chapters.label: Act II
chapters.title: The ordinary things
prose: Somewhere between good morning and goodnight, you became part of the rhythm of my days.
Some of my favourite memories were never trying to be important: food, colouring books, drives, jokes, a look held a little too long, and ordinary moments that became precious because you were there.

chapters.label: Act III
chapters.title: When we missed each other
prose: Two people can care about each other and still completely miss each other.

I spent too much time believing that if I explained myself accurately enough, understanding would follow. Sometimes you were asking me to understand you while I was still trying desperately to make myself understood.

chapters.label: Act IV
chapters.title: What remains
prose: I do not know which of these moments you carried too, and I do not want this page to answer that question for you.
These are simply the ones that stayed with me. Gratitude is louder than regret.

memories.title: The ordinary things
memories.summary: Morning messages, food, jokes, colouring, drives and the small moments that became important to me.
memories.herPrompt: How do you remember the ordinary days?

memories.title: Make me understand
memories.summary: There were moments when we cared and still failed to understand one another clearly.
memories.herPrompt: Only if you ever want to: what did those moments feel like from your side?

memories.title: What I carry
memories.summary: Whatever name you give these moments, I remember them with gratitude.
memories.herPrompt: Which moments, if any, stayed with you?
